name: @oc/runtime-claude
description: Durable Agent Sessions (v3) Claude runtime image: a Claude Agent SDK wrapper conforming to the v3 runtime contract (launch-durable-agent-sessions.md §5.9). Adapted from runtimes/claude: repoints /v2→/v3, drops the `kind` discriminator (top-level `type` only, §4.1), journals under OC_RUNTIME_STATE_DIR (§5.10), relies on the sealed ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + host egress proxy (no plaintext key in the VM, §5.7), and gates deliver/reconcile as coming-soon. Standalone — its own deps and build, kept out of the root tsc (built via its own toolchain).
